2610.02369.title: Automating the Application of HCI Principles: Skills for On-Demand UI Construction, the Human-AI Space to Think, and the Future of HCI
2610.02369.paper_summary: Human-computer interaction (HCI) is in the middle of a transition: large language models can now generate functional user interfaces (UIs) on demand from natural-language task descriptions. A user explains what they are trying to accomplish, and the system materializes a working interface to support it. This capability already exists in systems such as Claude and ChatGPT and continues to grow in fidelity as the underlying models improve. The next step along this trajectory is to move from interfaces that are merely generated to interfaces that are generated well. We propose a framework in which the dialogue between user and artificial intelligence (AI) becomes a Space to Think: a shared, structured cognitive workspace in which task decomposition produces an on-demand user interface as an extension of the user's thinking rather than as a separate artifact. Within this paradigm, classical HCI design knowledge (Nielsen's heuristics, Norman's affordance prescriptions, Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) success criteria, cognitive-load constraints, and mixed-initiative principles) is encoded as skills: machine-readable skill.md files that the generating agent loads at runtime as software engineering tools. Skills turn HCI design knowledge into declarative, inspectable, version-controlled, and editable artifacts owned by the HCI community itself so that accessibility, learnability, and consistency become properties of a generative process rather than properties of a finished product. We outline a research agenda depicting a future where the HCI field transitions from today's design and knowledge heuristic checklist towards a future where the craft becomes machine-readable, executable, and open.
2610.02369.paper_summary_zh: 人機互動（HCI）正處於一個轉型的過程中：大型語言模型現在可以根據自然語言任務描述按需生成功能性用戶界面（UIs）。用戶解釋他們想要達成的目標，系統則實現一個可用的界面來支持這一目標。這一能力已經存在於像Claude和ChatGPT這樣的系統中，並隨著基礎模型的改進而不斷提高其準確性。這一發展的下一步是從僅僅生成的界面轉向生成良好的界面。我們提出了一個框架，在這個框架中，用戶與人工智能（AI）之間的對話成為一個思考空間：一個共享的、結構化的認知工作空間，在這裡任務分解產生的按需用戶界面作為用戶思維的延伸，而不是作為一個獨立的產物。在這一範式中，經典的HCI設計知識（尼爾森的啟發式原則、諾曼的可供性規範、網頁內容無障礙指導方針（WCAG）成功標準、認知負擔約束和混合主動原則）被編碼為技能：可機器讀取的skill.md文件，生成代理在運行時將其加載作為軟件工程工具。技能將HCI設計知識轉化為可聲明的、可檢查的、版本控制的和可編輯的產物，這些產物由HCI社群自身擁有，使得可及性、可學習性和一致性成為生成過程的特性，而不是成品的特性。我們概述了一個研究議程，描繪了一個未來，在這個未來，HCI領域從今天的設計和知識啟發式檢查表過渡到一個未來，手藝變得可機器讀取、可執行和開放。
